name: alps-writer-plugins
//version: Intentionally pinned to 0.0.0 and NOT the release version. This package is private (never published to npm), so its version has no consumer. The release version lives in the plugin manifests — see scripts/bump-version.mjs.
description: Codex and Claude Code marketplace: ALPS authoring and ADR-driven development as two independent plugins.

scripts.build: bun scripts/vendor-report-diff.mjs && bun scripts/vendor-report-mermaid.mjs && bun scripts/sync-authoring-guidance.mjs && bun scripts/sync-report-skill.mjs && bun scripts/sync-shared-scripts.mjs && bun scripts/sync-search.mjs && bun run --filter alps-writer build
scripts.test: bun run test:checks && bun scripts/run-tests.mjs all
scripts.test:checks: bun scripts/vendor-report-diff.mjs --check && bun scripts/vendor-report-mermaid.mjs --check && bun scripts/sync-authoring-guidance.mjs --check && bun scripts/sync-report-skill.mjs --check && bun scripts/sync-shared-scripts.mjs --check && bun scripts/sync-search.mjs --check
scripts.test:workspace: bun run test:checks && bun scripts/run-tests.mjs workspace

author: haandol
//overrides: Security floors for vulnerable transitive releases. Bun overrides name a package, not a version range, so each floor applies to every copy of the package. KaTeX 0.18 keeps renderToString and the stylesheet Mermaid uses; minimatch 11 keeps the Minimatch#match and minimatch() ESLint uses; uuid 11 keeps the CommonJS DeepEval requires; puppeteer 25.16 drops the zod 3 chromium-bidi. The two OpenTelemetry trace exporters point at empty stubs in stubs/: DeepEval declares them, but the evals opt out of telemetry and never load them, and they alone pulled in gRPC and protobufjs.
//trustedDependencies: Only esbuild runs an install script. Puppeteer's browser download stays off: diagram rendering uses an existing browser or MERMAID_BROWSER_PATH.
